feature_importance_scope.model: LGBMRegressor (driver sensitivity analysis only; not used for final point forecasting)
feature_importance_scope.metric: Split count on StandardScaler-transformed full-period driver matrix

selected_forecast_model.name: Holt-Winters Additive (Undamped)
selected_forecast_model.specification: statsmodels ExponentialSmoothing(seasonal='add', seasonal_periods=12, trend='add', damped_trend=False, initialization_method='estimated') scaled in millions
selected_forecast_model.role_separation_note: Selected from the horizon-purged chronological model-selection split, ranking first at H=3, H=6, and H=12, with zero convergence failures and a coherent seasonal trajectory. Independent holdout results are evaluation evidence only; other candidates score better at some short horizons. LightGBM is retained strictly for nonlinear feature-importance analysis.

chronological_boundary_audit.selection_rule: Horizon-aware purged selection: o >= 2023-01-01 and target date (o + H) <= 2024-07-01
chronological_boundary_audit.note: Enforcing target <= 2024-07-01 eliminates multi-step calendar overlap at H=3, 6, 12 and reduces purged selection H=12 sample size to n=7 origins (2023-01..2023-07); Holt-Winters Additive (Undamped) ranks #1 across H=3, 6, 12 in purged selection.

prediction_range_methodology.label: Indicative Prediction Range
prediction_range_methodology.method: Step-specific out-of-sample RMSE (h=1..12) computed across rolling post-2023 origins (2023-01..2026-07, n=32..43 per step) scaled by z=1.960. Labelled Indicative Prediction Range rather than calibrated 95% CI due to modest post-COVID calibration sample size and structural regime shifts (including LRT Shah Alam opening in June 2026).
prediction_range_methodology.coverage_audit_note: Expanding-origin empirical coverage uses only residuals already realized at evaluation origin o (op + h <= o; strict op + h < o yields identical 98.6% mean coverage). Conservative over-coverage (92.0%-100.0%) reflects larger post-COVID recovery residuals in 2023 relative to calmer 2024-2026 demand.

limitations: Full-period Pearson correlations (r=-0.925 u_rate, r=+0.803 lf_employed, r=+0.674 diesel) are substantially driven by common post-COVID recovery trends; short-run first-differenced correlations drop below |0.14| for labour and fuel.
Pearson correlation measures linear co-movement only and does not establish causal ridership elasticity.
LRT Shah Alam launched paid service in late June 2026 (~0.7M-0.8M monthly ramp in Jul-Aug 2026), adding structural step-change uncertainty not seen in prior training years.
Prediction range uses out-of-sample RMSE (z=1.960) across 32-43 rolling post-2023 origins and is labelled Indicative Prediction Range rather than calibrated frequentist 95% coverage.
